relationships.subject: minocycline
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of microglia by infusing minocycline markedly decreased STZ-induced upregulation of microglial CXCL12

relationships.subject: AMD3100
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition of microglia or blockade of CXCR4 in ACC by infusing minocycline or AMD3100 significantly alleviated diabetic pain

key_findings: Microglial CXCL12 is upregulated in ACC of STZ diabetic mice and drives ACC glutamatergic neuron hyperactivity and pain via CXCR4.
Minocycline or AMD3100 in ACC alleviates diabetic pain.
